newsitem.title: USA: Costilla acquires reserves for $42 mln.
newsitem.headline: Costilla acquires reserves for $42 mln.

text.p: Costilla Energy Inc said on Thursday that it agreed to acquire proved reserves of 6 million barrels of oil equivalent and 160,000 undeveloped acres from Ballard Petroleum LLC for $42 million.
The acquisition, to be funded mostly through existing credit facilities, would be neutral to earnings in 1997 but accretive by 1998, the company said in a news release.
The acquisition would be accretive to cash-flow on a per-share basis in 1997, Costilla said.

The proved reserves and undeveloped acreage was in the Rocky Mountain region. Costilla also would acquire 150 square miles of 3-D seismic data and 42,000 miles of 2-D seismic data in Wyoming's Powder River Basin and Colorado's Paradox Basin, the company said.
Costilla said it anticipates budgeting $15 million for capital projects related to the acquired properties in the first 12 months, funded mostly through cash flow.
The deal would increase the percentage of Costilla's asset value that is in the Rocky Mountain region to 35 percent, from 25 percent.
Ballard is based in Billings, Mont.
